scope: Same-placement SRAM kernels through one ordinary APP. Not a resident Flash or end-to-end storage speed claim. Original scalar vs arithmetic Cyrillic priority vs bounded word blocks vs ARM SIMD32 blocks.

implementation.production_change: Cyrillic U+0410..U+044F maps arithmetically before the private-symbol table. All scalar outputs and rejection behavior remain identical.
implementation.experimental: Bounded groups of four printable ASCII or ordinary Russian characters; exceptional characters and malformed input use the strict scalar fallback.
implementation.code_context_limit: Forward scalar M8_to_UTF8 has identical source logic in legacy/mapped variants. Its timing difference comes from GCC outlining/merging in this shared TU and is not evidence that Cyrillic reverse-map priority changes that operation.
implementation.UTF16_reverse_DSP_limit: The DSP-labelled UTF16_to_M8 variant uses the same word arithmetic as word_blocks; it has no additional DSP instruction advantage.

measurement.compiler: xPack ARM GCC 14.2.1; noipa/16-byte-aligned/-Os wrappers in SRAM APP
measurement.native_edge_validation: Every M8 byte including invalid controls, malformed Cyrillic leads/tails, all 65536 BMP units in a four-unit block, and short capacities; repeated on each run.

reverse_mapping: virtual_fat.cpp: UTF-8 content import and UTF-16 LFN import
call_sites.UTF16_span_functions: Used by FAT LFN name conversion; names are short.
call_sites.UTF8_span_functions: Bulk public codec helpers have no direct firmware content caller today; VFAT import/export calls its scalar streaming boundary per character.
call_sites.future_integration: Batch streaming content conversion to feed bounded spans before expecting the word-kernel gains in real USB file throughput.

decisions.production: Apply the small reverse-map reorder; it benefits existing streaming callers without new tables or RAM.
decisions.word_blocks: Promising for homogeneous ASCII/Russian spans; mixed program text gains are smaller and exceptional-only input regresses.
decisions.DSP_blocks: About 2..3% over word code in Russian M8_to_UTF8/UTF16; little reason to prefer added ISA-specific code generally. UTF8_to_M8 Russian DSP is slower than word code.

tests.exhaustive_scalar_mapping: All codepoints 0..0x110000 plus large unsupported u32 values match frozen reference.
tests.host_ASan_UBSan: PASS; all BMP units in each lane, all UTF-8 byte pairs in each of four pair positions, random malformed input, all M8 bytes, capacities, partial-output/error contracts, alignments and exact protected-page input/output ends.
